basic_details.job_title: KV Chelgal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Pre-Primary Teachers, Music/Dance Coach Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kendriya Vidyalaya Chelgal (Jagtial, Telangana) has invited contractual Pre-Primary (Balvatika I, II and III) Teachers and a Music/Dance Coach (Primary) for Session 2026–2027 (Phase II). Applications are online only on the Samvida Sathi portal from 11 November 2026 to 20 November 2026. Interviews are on 20 November 2026 from 10:30 am at the KV Chelgal temporary campus, and candidates need Class XII with 50% marks plus the post-specific qualification.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online through the Samvida Sathi portal only. The notice states that no offline applications will be allowed.
Visit the Samvida Sathi portal at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/.
Log in to the registered portal.
Select KV CHELGAL as the school and apply for the available posts.
Take a printout and bring it to the interview as per the schedule.
important_instructions: Teachers engaged on contract have no claim or right to appointment on a regular basis and are not part of the cadre of teachers of Kendriya Vidyalayas. Contract teachers are not entitled to vacation pay; payment during Autumn/Winter Break is calculated on a pro rata basis. A teacher is not entitled to pay if absent on a working day; in case of absence from duty, payment is calculated on a pro rata basis. Working hours are the same as those of a regular teacher. No TA/DA will be provided for attending interviews. For more information, visit KV Chelgal at Old SP Office, Jagtial, Telangana, from 09:30 am to 2:40 pm.

content_sections.heading: About KV Chelgal
content_sections.text: Kendriya Vidyalaya Chelgal is a Kendriya Vidyalaya running from a temporary campus at the Old SP Office Building, Dharoor Camp, Jagtial, Telangana. This notice is issued by the Principal I/C of the Vidyalaya for contractual recruitment for Session 2026–2027 (Phase II). Teachers engaged on contract are not part of the regular cadre of Kendriya Vidyalaya teachers.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only candidates possessing the prescribed educational and professional qualifications for the respective posts will be permitted to attend the interview. Each post has its own requirements, given below. Essential: Senior Secondary class (Class XII or its equivalent) from a recognized board with at least 50% marks, AND Diploma in Nursery Teacher Education / Pre-school Education / Early Childhood Education Programme (D.E.C.Ed) of duration of not less than two years, or B.Ed. (Nursery) from an NCTE recognized institution. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English medium. Desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications; working knowledge of computers. Essential: Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (Class XII) with 50% marks from a recognized board. Bachelor Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized institution/university, provided music/performing arts was studied in all the years of the degree as a main subject. Competence to teach through English/Hindi medium. Candidates having a Diploma in Music are not eligible for this post. Desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications. For the full eligibility conditions of each post, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KV Chelgal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through the Samvida Sathi portal only. The notice states that no offline applications will be allowed. Visit the Samvida Sathi portal at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ . Complete the registration. Log in to the registered portal. Fill in the required details. Select KV CHELGAL as the school and apply for the available posts. Upload the required documents. Submit the application. Take a printout and bring it to the interview as per the schedule.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selections will be strictly as per the merit of candidates in the interviews only. The interview is on 20 November 2026 from 10:30 am onwards at KV Chelgal, Temporary Campus: Old SP Office Building, Dharoor Camp, Jagtial, Telangana – 505327. Results are scheduled to be declared on 22 November 2026; where they will appear is not specified in the notice. Documents to bring on the interview date: Printout of the online application. A set of Xerox copies for verification. Original documents, for verification purpose only.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Teachers engaged on contract have no claim or right to appointment on a regular basis and are not part of the cadre of teachers of Kendriya Vidyalayas. Contract teachers are not entitled to vacation pay; payment during Autumn/Winter Break is calculated on a pro rata basis. A teacher is not entitled to pay if absent on a working day; in case of absence from duty, payment is calculated on a pro rata basis. Working hours are the same as those of a regular teacher. No TA/DA will be provided for attending interviews. For more information, visit KV Chelgal at Old SP Office, Jagtial, Telangana, from 09:30 am to 2:40 pm.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KV Chelgal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of online registration on the Samvida Sathi portal is 20 November 2026. Registration opened on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are covered by KV Chelgal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice covers Pre-Primary Teachers for Balvatika I, II and III and Music/Dance Coach (Primary), on a contractual basis for Session 2026–2027 (Phase II).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Pre-Primary Teacher at KV Chelgal?
faq.answer: Class XII or equivalent with at least 50% marks, plus a Diploma in Nursery Teacher Education / Pre-school Education / Early Childhood Education (D.E.C.Ed) of not less than two years or B.Ed. (Nursery) from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Music/Dance Coach (Primary)?
faq.answer: Class XII with 50% marks from a recognized board and a Bachelor Degree in Music/Performing Arts, with that subject studied as a main subject in all years. Competence to teach through English/Hindi medium is also required.

faq.question: Q5. Is a Diploma in Music valid for the Music/Dance Coach post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates having a Diploma in Music are not eligible for the Music/Dance Coach (Primary) post.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for KV Chelgal contractual posts?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the Samvida Sathi portal at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/, selecting KV CHELGAL as the school. Offline applications are not allowed.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the KV Chelgal interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 20 November 2026 from 10:30 am onwards at KV Chelgal, Temporary Campus: Old SP Office Building, Dharoor Camp, Jagtial, Telangana – 505327.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is strictly as per the merit of candidates in the interviews only.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the KV Chelgal interview?
faq.answer: Bring the printout of the online application, a set of Xerox copies for verification and the original documents, which are used for verification only.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual and purely temporary, with no claim to regular appointment. No TA/DA is provided for attending interviews.
